kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
استشهدوا (form X)
# اِسْتَشْهَدُوا (istašhadū) /is.taʃ.ha.duː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada)
# اُسْتُشْهِدُوا (ustušhidū) /us.tuʃ.hi.duː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada) and اُسْتُشْهِدَ (ustušhida)
# اِسْتَشْهِدُوا (istašhidū) /is.taʃ.hi.duː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
